raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Wikipedia infobox and claimed the death place was “Tempio Malatestiano” (which is the burial site), while the visible infobox clearly listed “Castel Sismondo” as the place of death. This conflated burial location with place of death and introduced an incorrect, unsupported detail.
